batches.objective: Expose the resource and submission dependencies of the live ordinary Vulkan draw-recording path through narrow typed interfaces.
batches.rationale: The public query regression establishes a real native render-pass to queue submitter to run_render_draw consumer path. Its command recording still receives the whole runtime. Completed query and SPIR-V ownership batches remain closed.
batches.nextAction: Trace native render-pass snapshots through the queue caller, render resource acquisition, recording and completion; enumerate read-only inputs and permitted mutations before choosing one typed owner boundary.
acceptance: Identify the actual production consumer, complete execution path and observable consequence before editing.
Preserve public query/pixel output, recorded resource retention, failed-completion ownership and subsequent valid execution.
Retain focused checks and cost observations; give no parent review credit for interface extraction.
batches.stopCondition: Stop after one cohesive typed render-recording boundary and its evidence. Surface synchronization, attachment admission and other backends remain separately bounded obligations.
requiredEnvironment: Linux Vulkan for ordinary query/rendering output; platform-specific qualification remains separate.
